definitions.short: to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything
definitions.usage: cut (asunder, in sunder, down, off), hew down.
definitions.full: H1438. gada גָּדַע verb hew, hew down or off (Late Hebrew id. (rare), Aramaic גְּדַע Ithpe`el; Arabic cut off hand or other member, mutilate ) — Qal Perfect גָּדַע Lam 2:3 ; וְגָדַעְתִּ֫י 1Sam 2:31 ; Imperfect וָאָגְדַּע Zech 11:10 , 14 ; Participle passive גְּדוּעָה Isa 15:2 (so many editions but) Baer גְּרוּעָה ; compare below, גְּדֻעִים 10:33 ; — hew, cut in two , a staff Zech 11:10 , 14 ; metaphor hew off , an arm 1Sam 2:31 ; horns Lam 2:3 ; hew down , trees Isa 10:33 ; if in 15:2 then = shave off (object זקן , beard), but no other indication of this meaning, and true גְּרוּעָה ᵑ0 , compare Baer's note & Jer 48:37 ; see גרע . Niph`al Perfect נִגְדַּע Judg 21:6 נֶגְדַּע Jer 50:23 ; 3 feminine singular נִגְדְּעָה 48:25 ; וְנִגְדְּעָה consecutive Isa 22:25 ; 2 masculine singular נִגְדַּעְתָּ 14:12 ; 3 plural וְנִגְדְּעוּ consecutive Ezek 6:6 ; Amos 3:14 ; — be hewn off , of altar-horns 3:14 , of idols Ezek 6:6 (|| נשׁבר ); of severance of a tribe from nation Judg 21:6 ; figurative of king of Babylon Isa 14:12 ; of Babylon as hammer Jer 50:23 (|| נשׁבר ); of a minister, under figure of secure peg or pin Isa 22:25 ; of horn of Moab Jer 48:25 (|| נשׁבר ). Pi`el Perfect גִּדַּע 2Chr 34:7 , גִּדֵּ֑עַ 34:4 ; Psa 107:16 , וַיְגַדַּע 2Chr 14:2 , אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ Psa 7:5 ; Isa 45:2 , וַיְגַדְּעוּ 2Chr 31:1 ; 3 masculine plural תְּגַדֵּע֑וּן Deut 7:5 ; 12:3 ; — hew off, down, in two (compare Qal) of Asherîm 7:5 ; 2Chr 14:2 ; 31:1 , of idols Deut 12:3 ( מְּסִילִים ) 2Chr 34:4 , 7 ( חַמָּנִים ); figurative horns of wicked Psalm 75:11; bars of iron (i.e. of Babylon's gates) Isa 45:2 , compare Psa 107:16 . Pu`al Perfect גֻּדָּ֑עוּ Isa 9:9 hew down (of trees).
